subject: MAP: BrightWave pilot environment timeline & preflight checklist
messages:
From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@brightwave.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff & environment needs (API keys, peering, allowlist)

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo. We’re excited to move the BrightWave pilot forward. Before we lock dates I want to confirm the environment prerequisites so our infra team can schedule the window. Top-line asks:

- Org setup and admin invite (we need a service account and RBAC rules)
- API key provisioning for a dedicated tenant
- IP allowlist template for our outbound endpoints
- VPC peering requirements and timeline (customer-managed cloud)

Can you share a short MAP of milestones and who on Redwood owns each item? We’re targeting a soft go-live for the pilot staging on 2028-07-05 (two-week sandbox).

Attaching a single-sheet summary of our acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Emma Wong
Director, Platform Ops
BrightWave Health
[Attachment: BW-pilot-acceptance.pdf (PDF)]

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@brightwave.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff & environment needs (API keys, peering, allowlist)

Emma —

Great to hear. I’ve started a short MAP draft and looped Marissa (on enablement) and Neha (on infra/security). Quick answers up front:

- Org & RBAC: Redwood will create the tenant and invite your SAML admin; service account provisioning is 1 business day once we have the SAML and admin email. Owner: Marissa.
- API keys: We can issue scoped API keys for a pilot tenant; we recommend ephemeral keys for the sandbox. Owner: Sergio (ops).
- IP allowlist: Please use the attached CSV template and list the egress IPs you will use. Owner: Neha.
- VPC peering: We support AWS/GCP peering. We'll need your VPC CIDR, account ID, and peering contact. Estimated lead time: 3–5 business days once we have those details. Owner: Neha.

I’m attaching our MAP spreadsheet (first pass) and a short peering checklist. Suggested next step: 30-min preflight call Monday to review handoffs and sign the MAP.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: BrightWave_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel), vpc-peering-guide.pdf (PDF)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@brightwave.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP v1: milestones & acceptance (attached)

Hi Emma / Samir —

Uploading the first MAP tab that breaks the pilot into milestones and owners. Highlights:

1) Tenant & Admin Setup (Target: 2028-06-20) — deliverables: tenant created, admin invited, SAML test complete. Owner: Marissa.
2) API Keys & Scopes (Target: 2028-06-21) — deliverables: scoped API key, QA key rotation schedule. Owner: Sergio.
3) Network Allowlist (Target: 2028-06-22) — deliverables: validated IP allowlist CSV and test calls. Owner: Neha.
4) VPC Peering Window (Target: 2028-06-26 to 2028-06-28) — deliverables: peering completed, routing validated. Owner: Neha + BrightWave infra.
5) Pilot Smoke & Acceptance (Target: 2028-07-05) — deliverables: smoke tests green, acceptance signoff. Owner: BrightWave / Redwood.

Notes / asks for BrightWave:
- Please fill the IP allowlist template and return to Neha by EOD 6/21.
- For peering, provide VPC CIDR and account ID by 6/21 so we can schedule the 6/26 window.

I’ve attached the MAP as a single workbook (MAP, network, test checklist). Let’s confirm the preflight call for Monday 6/19 11:00 AM PT if that works.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Enablement
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightWave_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@brightwave.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v1: milestones & acceptance (attached)

Emma / Samir —

Thanks for the MAP — a couple of infra clarifications from our side so scheduling is smooth:

- IP allowlist: use the attached CSV (column: name, ip, region, TTL). If you have NAT or a load balancer with ephemeral egress, please call that out — ephemeral egress will require a different approach (we can allow a /24 for the pilot but prefer static IPs).
- Peering pre-reqs: we need your cloud account/project number, VPC CIDR, intended peering subnet, and a contact with permissions to accept peering. If Azure, provide peering resource group.
- Firewall: ensure ports 443 (TLS) and 5222 (if using internal telemetry) are open between subnets.

I’ve penciled the peering ops window for 6/26 09:00–11:00 PT and the validation sprint 6/27 13:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm availability.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Infra & Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ip-allowlist-template.csv (CSV)]

From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@brightwave.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v1: milestones & acceptance (attached)

Team —

All looks good. Quick status update from BrightWave infra:

- IP allowlist: attached with our outbound NAT IPs; we confirmed static egress for the sandbox.
- VPC info: account ID 987654321, VPC CIDR 10.40.0.0/16, peering admin is Samir (cc’d).
- We accept the 6/26 peering window and will have Samir on the call to validate routing and run smoke tests.

We’ll sign the MAP and return the doc by end of day. Once the peering + keys are in place, we’ll run smoke tests on 7/03 and aim for pilot staging on 7/05.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — see you Monday on the preflight call.

Best,
Emma Wong
Director, Platform Ops
BrightWave Health
[Attachment: brightwave_ip_allowlist_return.csv (CSV)]
